// as: packages/vault/src/secret/probe.ts
// expect: sax/no-secret-stringify=15
// 비밀 값을 문자열·JSON으로 만드는 경로(D05 §2 no-secret-stringify).
declare const secret: Uint8Array;
declare const certPassword: Uint8Array;
declare const held: { secretBytes: Uint8Array; pin: Uint8Array };
declare const maybe: { secretBytes: Uint8Array; pin: Uint8Array } | undefined;
declare function send(s: string): void;
send(JSON.stringify({ certPassword }));
send(JSON.stringify(held.secretBytes));
send(String(secret));
send(secret.toString());
send(`pw=${certPassword}`);
send('pin:' + held.pin);
send(new TextDecoder().decode(held.secretBytes));
send(Buffer.from(secret).toString('utf8'));
console.log('debug', { value: secret });
send(held.pin.join(''));
send(secret + certPassword);
send(JSON.stringify(maybe?.secretBytes));
send(String(maybe?.pin));
send(`pw=${maybe?.pin}`);
send('x' + maybe?.pin);
